title: Microsoft Edge: Allow users to translate PDF documents into their preferred language
description: Users will be able to translate full PDF documents directly within the native PDF viewer in Microsoft Edge. The translated document opens in a new tab, making it easier to access content in their preferred language.  Admins can control availability to this feature using the TranslateEnabled policy.
